ModMetadata.Name: HTTP Instructions
ModMetadata.Author: aproposmath, JacksonTheMaster
ModMetadata.Description:
Adds HTTP GET/POST instructions and local HTTP endpoints for IC10.
Examples: http_get 'http://host/value' r0 http_post 'http://host/data' '${r0}' http_on_get 8080 /status '{"value":${r0}}' http_on_post 8080 /sensor '{"r1":"value","r2":"$success"}'
Use output mappings to read JSON fields into registers. Strings are packed with STR().
[b]WARNING[/b] This mod can impose severe security risks, only run it if you know what you are doing. ONLY run workshop scripts using this mod if you either - fully understand the code - ultimately trust the author
[b]Installation[/b] This is a [b]StationeersLaunchPad[/b] Plugin Mod. It requires BepInEx to be installed. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
Source Code: https://github.com/aproposmath/StationeersHTTPInstructions
